description: This is an HTML file for a web-based database visualizer interface, providing frontend UI components for listing databases, tables, and displaying table data with interactive features.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes database list with a spinner indicating loading

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses database's tables list and loads tables

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for selected database

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data from selected table

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders data in tabular form with interactive cells

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell based on value type and length

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for wide or object data
